title: [YSQL][randgen] Bitmap scan plan returns wrong results
body:
Jira Link: [DB-10409](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-10409)
### Description

Problem
---
* Reproducible on a recent master (305dbefe92).

```
YB test# SELECT table1.col_time_key AS field1 FROM (  SELECT * FROM C  )  AS table1  WHERE  EXISTS (  SELECT  FROM CC  AS SUBQUERY3_t1  WHERE SUBQUERY3_t1 .col_varchar_key  >= table1 .col_varchar_nokey  OR SUBQUERY3_t1 .pk  =  194  )  OR table1 .col_varchar_key  = 'p'  ;
     field1
-----------------
 22:34:09.023306
 14:26:02.007788
 14:03:03.042673
 18:56:33.027423
 <null>
 09:29:08.048031
 11:57:26.013363
 03:28:15.007081
 06:44:18.007092
(9 rows)

YB test# EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) SELECT table1.col_time_key AS field1 FROM (  SELECT * FROM C  )  AS table1  WHERE  EXISTS (  SELECT  FROM CC  AS SUBQUERY3_t1  WHERE SUBQUERY3_t1 .col_varchar_key  >= table1 .col_varchar_nokey  OR SUBQUERY3_t1 .pk  =  194  )  OR table1 .col_varchar_key  = 'p'  ;
                                         QUERY PLAN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Seq Scan on c
   Filter: ((SubPlan 1) OR ((col_varchar_key)::text = 'p'::text))
   SubPlan 1
     ->  YB Bitmap Table Scan on cc subquery3_t1
           ->  BitmapOr
                 ->  Bitmap Index Scan on cc_varchar_key
                       Index Cond: ((col_varchar_key)::text >= (c.col_varchar_nokey)::text)
                 ->  Bitmap Index Scan on cc_pkey
                       Index Cond: (pk = 194)
(9 rows)
```
**PG15 results**:
```
PG15 test# SELECT table1.col_time_key AS field1 FROM (  SELECT * FROM C  )  AS table1  WHERE  EXISTS (  SELECT  FROM CC  AS SUBQUERY3_t1  WHERE SUBQUERY3_t1 .col_varchar_key  >= table1 .col_varchar_nokey  OR SUBQUERY3_t1 .pk  =  194  )  OR table1 .col_varchar_key  = 'p'  ;

     field1
-----------------
 22:34:09.023306
 14:26:02.007788
 14:03:03.042673
 16:21:18.052408
 18:56:33.027423
 <null>
 09:29:08.048031
 19:11:10.040728
 11:57:26.013363
 03:28:15.007081
 06:44:18.007092
 14:36:39.062494
 18:42:45.053707
 16:46:13.01546
 19:39:02.040624
 20:58:33.049572
(16 rows)
```
**YB returns the same results as PG15 with Bitmap scan disabled:**
```
YB test# /*+ Set(enable_bitmapscan OFF) */SELECT table1.col_time_key AS field1 FROM (  SELECT * FROM C  )  AS table1  WHERE  EXISTS (  SELECT  FROM CC  AS SUBQUERY3_t1  WHERE SUBQUERY3_t1 .col_varchar_key  >= table1 .col_varchar_nokey  OR SUBQUERY3_t1 .pk  =  194  )  OR table1 .col_varchar_key  = 'p'  ;
     field1
-----------------
 22:34:09.023306
 14:26:02.007788
 14:03:03.042673
 16:21:18.052408
 18:56:33.027423
 <null>
 09:29:08.048031
 19:11:10.040728
 11:57:26.013363
 03:28:15.007081
 06:44:18.007092
 14:36:39.062494
 18:42:45.053707
 16:46:13.01546

(16 rows)
```

Test Case
---
```
CREATE TABLE c (
    pk integer NOT NULL,
    col_time_key time without time zone,
    col_varchar_key character varying(1),
    col_varchar_nokey character varying(1),
    CONSTRAINT c_pkey PRIMARY KEY(pk ASC)
);


CREATE TABLE cc (
    pk integer NOT NULL,
    col_int_nokey integer,
    col_int_key integer,
    col_varchar_key character varying(1),
    col_varchar_nokey character varying(1),
    CONSTRAINT cc_pkey PRIMARY KEY(pk ASC)
);
```
